provenance.encodes: The Indigo Book, R22.2 (statute short form: `§ 1983`)
provenance.how_to_verify: Open the Indigo Book (https://law.resource.org/pub/us/code/blue/IndigoBook.html, CC0), R22.2 (statute short form: `§ 1983`), and compare the form and examples with this pattern.

positive.text: Claims under 42 U.S.C. § 1983 accrue later. Under § 1983, the claim fails.

negative: Cal. Civ. Code § 1550 applies, and V.I. Code Ann. tit. 1, § 97-89 too.
Restatement (Third) of Prop.: Servitudes § 7.1 and Nimmer on Copyright § 1.01 are treatises.

note: A bare section after a full statute or regulation cite. L3 resolves it to the latest earlier statute or regulation with the same section and inherits that authority; unresolved, it drops below policy.min_confidence (0.6 - 0.3) and is only a CITE020 cue. reject_before leaves a section sign after a code name, title, article, Restatement or treatise title (`of Torts §`, `on Copyright §`) to the code, secondary and catch-all rules.
